headline: Where to find Coralum Ore in Palworld
title: Where to Find Coralum Ore in Palworld | Whalaska Farm | Palworld Guide
video_script: Coralum Ore can't be mined from a node in Palworld one point zero. Instead, hunt Whalaska on the Isle of the Glacial Core, at around one thirty nine, six forty. Each one drops Coralum Ore. Or collect ocean salvage around Feybreak Island. For a steady supply, breed Whalaska at your base and butcher them with a Pal Disassembly Conveyor. You need the ingots for lots of late game builds. How do you get yours? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 Coralum Ore: not mined. Hunt Whalaska on the Isle of the Glacial Core (around 139, 640), use Feybreak ocean salvage, or breed and butcher Whalaska at your base.
